info.title: IP WHOIS Lookup API - Organization, CIDR & Abuse Contact Data
info.description: Retrieve WHOIS registration and ownership data for any IPv4 or IPv6 address from the appropriate Regional Internet Registry (ARIN, RIPE NCC, APNIC, LACNIC, or AFRINIC). Returns the IP range (inet_num) with CIDR blocks, net name, allocation status, and parent blocks; the registering organization with full address and contact handles; technical and abuse contacts with email and phone; BGP route objects; and the raw WHOIS response. The irt (IRT) object is included when available, containing the internet response team's address, abuse mailbox, and linked contacts.

get.summary: Retrieve WHOIS registration and ownership data for an IP address
get.description: Returns WHOIS details for an IPv4 or IPv6 address including IP range, organization, contacts, routes, and raw WHOIS output.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.
